name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
summary: Magatha Grimtotem seeks retribution after troggs slaughter her emissaries beneath Orgrimmar. Rahauro on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise sends warriors into Ragefire Chasm to cull the troggs infesting it.

sections.title: Diplomacy Meets Savagery
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem sent tauren emissaries into the fiery depths beneath Orgrimmar to make peace with the troggs. The creatures slaughtered the delegates as soon as they arrived. Magatha saw the massacre as an insult to the tauren and a growing danger to the Horde. She resolved to answer it with force.

sections.title: The Threat Beneath Orgrimmar
sections.body: Rahauro carries out Magatha’s orders from Thunder Bluff. He directs warriors into Ragefire Chasm to find and kill trogg warriors and shamans. The Horde strikes deep into their underground home to thin their numbers before they can pour through their tunnels into Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why is a quest for an Orgrimmar dungeon handed out in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: The tauren leadership assigned the work in Thunder Bluff. Magatha Grimtotem sent diplomats into Ragefire Chasm to meet the troggs, and after they were slaughtered, her assistant Rahauro organized warriors on the Elder Rise to avenge them.

Rahauro is a tauren who coordinates expeditions into Ragefire Chasm from the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. He acts for Magatha Grimtotem, sending warriors to kill troggs and recover relics lost during earlier failed diplomatic missions.

faq.q: Why did Magatha Grimtotem attempt peace with troggs?
faq.answer: Magatha Grimtotem sent the emissaries as an act of goodwill, hoping to make relations with the subterranean beings instead of shedding blood. The troggs slaughtered her delegates when they arrived, showing no willingness to parley.

faq.q: What enemies need to be slain for this task?
faq.answer: You enter Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar to slay Ragefire Troggs and Ragefire Shamans. Their deaths weaken the trogg front lines and their spellcasting support.

faq.q: Can this quest be completed alongside other dungeon tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Rahauro also offers Searching for the Lost Satchel, which sends you into the same chasm to find the remains of the failed diplomatic party. You can undertake both together.

faq.q: Where are the troggs coming from?
faq.answer: The troggs emerged from deep volcanic fissures beneath Durotar. When Rahauro speaks after the fighting, the Horde still knows little about where these cave dwellers came from or why they are digging upward into Orgrimmar now.

angles.text: As a tauren, you strike in retribution for the diplomats killed in Ragefire Chasm, on behalf of the Elder Rise.
As an orc, you help protect the heart of your capital from troggs tunneling beneath the city.
As a shaman, you face trogg spiritual practitioners who wield primal elements in the lava tunnels, a crude mirror of your honored traditions.
As a member of the Horde, you see Thunder Bluff commit warriors and resources to protect Orgrimmar’s foundations.
